name: 24739 · Princeton, WV
findings: ZIP 24739 (Princeton) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24739 (Princeton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 24739 (Princeton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
